text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, I will not run like I did last 
time."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This is proof of my resolve... Will you 
accept it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the envelope was a handwritten 
newspaper article from Writer C—Chrono 
Genesis.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a special column written just 
for you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Glory from Downwind"—Having tasted defeat 
and drunk from the bitter cup, the 
Umamusume splendidly avenges her loss.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I will make this article a reality...!
choice_data_list: I know Chrono can absolutely do it!
